usedFor: Ascora holds jobs, quotes and enquiries, and Calendly returns a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link” after “Quote Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Quote Created” in Ascora, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Once a quote exists the customer needs a time to talk, and the action creates that booking link.

watchOut: “Quote Modified” also exists in Ascora, so stay on “Quote Created” or every edit makes another scheduling link.
